title: Local model: measure which roles each local launcher suits
lead: *Proposed:* decide, with measured runs, which roles each of claude-local, codex-local and grok-local should hold in the matrix. Today only qwen3.8-27b is served, and the owner's guidance on what suits local is a judgment, not a measurement (S301 Why).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The owner wants the matrix tuned by evidence, not by guess: local rows start size S and well specified (owner, 2026-11-07), and the rest is open.
- The local server is weaker and slower than the cloud models, handles about 2 to 4 concurrent requests (owner estimate), and serves one model at a time.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None; this slice records measurements and matrix changes. Any ork code change it needs gets its own failing test in the slice that makes it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. With the owner, choose a fixed set of small slices of known difficulty and run each role (implementer, reviewer, gate, spec check, UI pass) on each local launcher through a per-run lineup override.
2. Record, per role and launcher: pass or fail, rounds used, time, and findings missed against a cloud review of the same diff.
3. Propose matrix rows and conditions from the record; the owner decides them (adj record).
4. Do not change a default role to local without an owner decision (adj 181).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The measurements are in the handoff note with the commands that produced them.
- `slicer check`, `adj lint`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: - Branch and worktree per AGENTS.md; no commit until the owner approves.
